commit.message:
Reject Ed25519 signatures with S >= L in the verifier (GH #1355)

Donna only checks that the top three bits of S are clear, so a signature with the group order added to S still verified. Check S < L in ed25519Verifier::VerifyAndRestart and ed25519Verifier::VerifyStream.

Refs #1352
